note: Honest audit: of 50 Category-D tools, only tool-177 (Caption Readability Checker) uses a genuine published numeric formula. Tool-185 (Account Audit Checklist) uses a transparent custom additive score defined below. All other D tools are template/word-bank/checklist engines with no numeric formulas — that is correct and intentional, not a gap.
